name: Install the kernel's build dependencies
run:
sudo apt-get update -q
sudo apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends bc bison flex libelf-dev libssl-dev

name: Install kernel.org GCC 15.2.0 for sh4-linux
run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$HOME/cross"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/x86_64-gcc-15.2.0-nolibc-sh4-linux.tar.xz" https://mirrors.edge.kernel.org/pub/tools/crosstool/files/bin/x86_64/15.2.0/x86_64-gcc-15.2.0-nolibc-sh4-linux.tar.xz
echo "c56269d882cd44f2c9187c2f0f2dfebd76e994a00a28a2ff11a77863abf01ba5  $RUNNER_TEMP/x86_64-gcc-15.2.0-nolibc-sh4-linux.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xJf "$RUNNER_TEMP/x86_64-gcc-15.2.0-nolibc-sh4-linux.tar.xz" -C "$HOME/cross"
"$HOME/cross/gcc-15.2.0-nolibc/sh4-linux/bin/sh4-linux-gcc" --version
